answer.new_information: NN, Inc. (not in the NVDA research scope) announced in late June 2026 that 47 machine centers would be added at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling of NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards. Its 2026 target of US$80-90 million of accretive new business is a company target, not a result. The 2028 revenue and earnings figures are a third-party narrative and unnamed analyst estimates, and the Russell Microcap Value removal is a fact reported by Yahoo. None of these is a period or definition that matches a stored question, and no questions, pieces or catalog entries exist to update.
answer.reason: The record is a Yahoo Finance pickup of a supplier's announcement. There are no stored pieces, catalog questions or comparison opinion to revise, and NN is outside the NVDA research scope. The new capacity is a supplier-side pre-sale claim relayed by one outlet, with no size or NVIDIA-side confirmation. It is context that moves no existing number, so it is background only and does not justify a new investment judgement.
